title: pancake dispenser
text: pancake dispenser. So.... this probably works great for the photo... thin syrups for ice cream?  But pancake batter is pretty thick.  In order to get this work, I had to thin out the pancake batter quite a bit.  It did work - but pancakes were thinner due to thinner batter.  Be sure to put a plate under the wire holder - because you have to use a thinner batter, it will leak.  Works.. but wish the opening was bigger with a working gasket closer.
